title: Monsoon Zucchini Fritters
description: A flavorful vegetarian dish that combines the sweetness of zucchini with the brightness of lemon zest. Perfect as a snack or side for any meal.
instructions: Shred the zucchini and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, parmesan cheese, salt, and pepper.
Add the shredded zucchini and chopped monsoon to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop the zucchini mixture into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of parmesan cheese.
